split.note: Decided by the user before any test run. Held-out scenarios must not be used for development, tuning or dev-only scoring.

baselines.note: detector_order is set from the M3 dev triage precision (aminer > wazuh > suricata on both dev scenarios); it is a dev-derived, documented choice, frozen on 2026-11-07 before any held-out run. Every k in top_k is reported; agent runs add a k matched to the agent's mean citations per case.

pilot.note: The pilot runs on dev scenarios only; held-out scenarios stay untouched. Both truncation rules are reported side by side.
